command:
set -eu
entry=$(getent passwd inventorysvc)
printf 'passwd_entry=[REDACTED] "$entry"
uid=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d: -f3)
home=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d: -f6)
shell=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d: -f7)
printf 'uid=%s system_uid=%s home=%s shell=%s\n' "$uid" "$(if [ "$uid" -lt 1000 ]; then printf yes; else printf no; fi)" "$home" "$shell"
id inventorysvc
passwd -S inventorysvc
stat -c 'home_type=%F owner=%U group=%G mode=%a path=%n' /var/lib/inventory
set +e
runuser -u inventorysvc -- /usr/sbin/nologin
login_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'nologin_exit=%s\n' "$login_rc"
[ "$uid" -lt 1000 ]
[ "$home" = /var/lib/inventory ]
[ "$shell" = /usr/sbin/nologin ]
[ "$login_rc" -ne 0 ]
